name: Issuance approval screen is not displayed when WRPRC validation fails
scenarioId: ios/Relying_Party_Registration_Certificate_184/RPRC_ISSU_02_Wallet_warns_Wallet_user_when_provider_registration_certificate_validation_fails_310/RPRCISSU02WalletWarnsWalletUserWhenProviderRegistrationCertificateValidationFails:Issuance approval screen is not displayed when WRPRC validation fails
methodName: Issuance approval screen is not displayed when WRPRC validation fails

testSteps.description: Given the user is registered to a valid EUDI Wallet on their device
And a Provider's Access Certificate is available
And the issuer metadata includes a WRPRC
And the Wallet automatically validates the WRPRC before displaying any issuance approval screen
Given the provider has sent an offer containing issuer metadata with a WRPRC
Then the Wallet does not display the issuance approval screen
And the Wallet displays a blocker stating that the provider could not be validated

userStory.storyName: Warning when the provider's registration certificate cannot be validated
userStory.displayName: Warning when the provider's registration certificate cannot be validated
userStory.narrative:
As a Wallet user,
  I want to be clearly warned if the provider's registration certificate could not be validated,
  So that I can make an explicit and informed decision about whether to proceed with receiving the attestation or PID.

title: Issuance approval screen is not displayed when WRPRC validation fails
